Clarifications

Frequently Asked Questions

Are all Embroshyal furniture pieces made from genuine solid wood?

Yes. We exclusively use Grade-A Burmese Teak and American White Oak seasoned down to 8–10% moisture content in our controlled kiln chambers. We never compromise on structural durability with cheap MDF or low-grade particle boards in our core frames.

How does the 3D Architectural Design Consultation work?

Our interior architects provide a complimentary consultation either virtually or in-home. We analyze your floor plan, lighting, and lifestyle requirements to generate photorealistic 3D spatial renders and detailed material swatches at zero charge.

What does Complimentary White-Glove Installation cover?

Every order includes scheduled room-of-choice placement, uncrating, full precision joinery assembly by factory-trained artisans, leveling, hardware tuning, and complete packaging removal with zero mess left behind.

What is the delivery timeline for made-to-order pieces?

In-stock items ship within 48 to 72 hours. Custom handcrafted pieces with bespoke upholstery fabrics or stone cuts typically require 3 to 4 weeks for artisanal creation and seasoning.
